chapter.verse: Topa ka phat ding a, ka lungsim khempeuh tawh ama min siangtho ka phat ding hi.
T opa ka phat ding a, ama migitna ka mangngilh kei ding hi.
Amah in ka mawhna khempeuh hong maisak a, ka natna khempeuh hong dam sak hi.
Hankhuk tung ding hong suakta sak a, itna leh hehpihna tampi hong pia hi.
Muvanlai bangin ka thahat theih nadingin thupha namkim hong pia hi.
Topa in, a kinengniam mi khempeuh adingin thuman, thutangin thu a khen hi.
Amah in ama geelna, Moses tungah gen a, ama nasepnate, Israel mite a musak hi.
Topa dik-in hehpihna tawh kidim a, heh hak-in, a lian mahmah itna kip tawh kidim hi.
Amah in hong taai ngitnget lo ding a, amah heh paisuak lo ding hi.
Amah in, eite’ khialhna tawh kituakin hong bawl loin, eite’ mawhna tawh kituakin hong thukkik lo hi.
Vantung in leitung panin a san’ mah bangin, amah a zahtakte tungah ama itna kip lianin sang mahmah hi,
nisuahna pen nitumna panin a gamlat mah bangin, eite tung panin i mawhna daante gamlapi-ah amah in a nilkhia hi.
Pa in a tate a hehpih bangin, Topa in amah a zahtakte hong hehpih hi.
Bang hang hiam cih leh amah in eite’ pian’na hong thei hi; eite leivui i hihna a phawk hi.
Mihing ahih leh ama nuntak hunin lopa tawh kibang hi; lo lai a paakte bangin amah palh hi;
bang hang hiam cih leh huih in amah seem-in beimang a, tua mun in amah thei kha nawn lo hi.

Ahih hangin, Topa ’ itna kip pen, amah a zahtak mite tungah a tawntung panin a tawntung dongin kip ngitnget a, ama thumanna pen, ama thuciamna zui-in a thupiakna bangin sep ding a phawk mite’ tungah a khang khangin kip tawntung hi.
Topa in ama tokhom vantungah phut khin a, amah in mun khempeuh a uk hi.
Ama thugen a ngai, ama thu bang-a a sem no a thahat, no ama vantung mite aw, Topa phat un!
Ama deih banga gamta ama nasem, ama vantungmi hon khempeuhte aw, Topa phat un!
Ama ukna mun khempeuh ah a om, ama bawlsate aw, Topa phat un. Ke’n, Topa ka phat ding hi.
